name: io.github.vish288/mcp-argocd
description: Argo CD MCP server for MCP 2026-07-28: app status, sync, rollback, drift, logs, ApplicationSets

environmentVariables.name: ARGOCD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Argo CD bearer token (also accepts ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN or ARGOCD_API_TOKEN)

environmentVariables.name: ARGOCD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Argo CD base URL including any path prefix (e.g. https://argocd.example.com)
